resources.string: Point and pinch to tap, move two fingers to scroll, or swipe three fingers for Back and Home.

GestureOS draws a touch-through cursor and performs confirmed pinch taps, two-finger scrolling swipes and three-finger Back/Home navigation. Enable camera tracking and the separate system-wide cursor switch in GestureOS to activate it. Camera frames stay on this tablet. Stop tracking or disable the cursor to end control.

System cursor activation enables background tracking for Home and other apps. Manually enable GestureOS cursor control in Android Accessibility settings, then activate this switch. If Android shows Restricted setting, open App permissions → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, then return to Accessibility. Tune cursor applies to both cursor modes.
Start the camera and manually enable GestureOS cursor control in Accessibility settings.
Accessibility disconnected. Enable it manually in Settings.
System cursor off. Enable it explicitly when ready.
System control ON. Point and pinch to tap. Hold two fingers then move to scroll. Hold three fingers then swipe left for Back or up for Home.
Waiting for a fresh frame and display geometry.
Screen locked or off. Return to GestureOS and enable the cursor again.
Tracking, camera access or accessibility became unavailable. Enable the cursor again after recovery.
Display orientation or geometry changed. Enable the cursor again.
Accessibility interrupted. Enable the cursor again.
Cursor overlay could not attach. Check accessibility access.
Android rejected the action. System control disarmed.
Android cancelled the gesture. System control disarmed.
Gesture result timed out. System control disarmed. Reconnect accessibility if dispatch stays busy.
A previous gesture is still finishing. System control disarmed.

Scroll with index and middle extended, ring and little curled, thumb tucked. For Back/Home also extend the ring finger. Hold still to arm, then move. Close your hand briefly before each new navigation attempt.

All control modes switch off while tuning. Hold index and middle extended to scroll. Also extend ring for navigation. Tuck the thumb away from the fingertips. Hold still to arm, then move left for Back or up for Home. Close the hand to re-arm navigation. Movement uses the palm centre inside the cursor active region. Swipe direction follows hand movement. Repeats require continued movement. Defaults need T20 calibration.
Movement dead zone (0.01–0.06 of active region)
Scroll travel threshold (0.04–0.25, at least 2 × dead zone)
Scroll repeat interval (250–2000 ms, at least duration + 100)
Navigation travel (0.10–0.40, at least 3 × dead zone)
Maximum navigation movement duration (400–2000 ms, above minimum)
Check the displayed ranges, threshold/dead-zone ratios, duration and repeat interval.
Navigation ready · left Back / up Home
Close hand briefly to re-arm navigation
Pose changed during movement · close hand to retry
Movement too fast · close hand to retry
Movement timed out · close hand to retry
Use left for Back or up for Home · close hand to retry
Navigation cooldown · close hand before retrying
Show one hand, 60–90 cm from the front camera. Try an open palm, a closed fist, or a vertical thumbs-up / thumbs-down. Hold each pose until confirmed.

Camera frames are processed on this tablet and never stored. Background tracking continues until stopped. System cursor control continues while enabled. In-app cursor and volume actions suspend when you leave this screen.
Enable before starting, or during tracking. Use Stop camera or the notification to finish. In-app cursor and volume actions require this screen.
Notifications are hidden. Allow notifications in App settings for the Stop action, or stop here or through Android Active apps.
Recognising hands in the background. Tap to return.
Recognising hands while GestureOS is visible.
Camera permission was revoked. Grant access and start tracking again.
Camera service could not start. Return to GestureOS and try again.
Camera service disconnected. Start tracking again.
Camera permission is needed for local hand tracking. Tap Start camera to allow it.
Camera permission denied. Try Start camera again, or allow Camera under App permissions if Android no longer asks.
Camera or tracking unavailable: %1$s. Check Camera access in Android Quick Settings, close other camera apps, then tap Start camera to retry.
No recent tracking frames. Check camera privacy and other camera apps, or stop and restart.
UNRECOGNISED · keep the whole hand visible

Release any held thumb, then confirm thumbs-up or thumbs-down. Keep holding to repeat if enabled.

Pinch confirmed between targets. Point at a target and try again.
Point with the index finger; curl the others. Move within the preview rectangle, then touch thumb to index and hold briefly to select a target.
Cursor off. Cursor mode and volume mode are mutually exclusive.
Show a released pointing pose to arm the cursor. Selections affect only the six targets.
Analysis → cursor draw: %1$d ms · mean %2$.0f ms (last 30). Excludes sensor exposure and display scanout.
Cursor-update latency appears while pointing (analysis start → draw).

Both action modes switch off while tuning. Region edges are fractions of the visible camera image; each span must be at least 0.30. Smaller regions or higher sensitivity reduce required hand travel. Pinch release must exceed entry by at least 0.10. Re-enable the cursor afterward.
Pointer dead zone (0–0.03 of target area)
